what: the film's object changes state before the viewer's eyes (full to empty, whole to broken, small to huge); two short words say from what to what; the object, its drawing and its motion are code's
use_when: the film has an idea (concept) and its object really does change: the before and after are the story
avoid_when: news, crime, incidents or deaths (refused); a film with no idea; two values of a number (change)
rules: "state": at most one, only with THE FILM'S IDEA above: was and now are the object before and after, the source's own words, a number only if the articles have it; never name a cause the source doesn't;
